title: Preflight bridge for immutable EKS control-plane upgrades in Redwood Private provisioning
creator: Nora Kim
description:
Goal: Add a lightweight, idempotent Terraform 'preflight bridge' layer that validates and executes safe, immutable control-plane upgrades for Redwood Private EKS provisioning. The bridge sits between the provisioning pipeline and the final immutable Terraform apply and performs a set of automated checks and canary validations so upgrades can be rolled out with reduced blast radius.

Scope: implement Terraform module and orchestration helpers that perform: (1) schema and drift detection (pre-apply diff checks), (2) node/control-plane readiness gating (cluster API level and AWS API probes), (3) canary promotion flow (apply to canary VPC/cluster or subset control-plane then promote), (4) automated health-check assertions (control-plane endpoints, kube-apiserver metrics, pod start latency for core system components), and (5) safe rollback hooks and annotated runbook links for operator intervention.

Design notes: prefer immutable upgrades (replace control-plane nodes / stacks) rather than in-place patching to minimize long-tail regressions. The bridge will be implemented primarily with Terraform modules (wrapper + preflight data sources) and a small orchestration Lambda (or step function) that sequences checks and triggers the final apply via Terraform Cloud or CI runner. Health assertions are pluggable so teams can add workload-specific checks.

Success criteria: (a) automated preflight catches schema/drift mismatches and prevents a dangerous apply in >95% of test cases, (b) automated canary promotion reduces observed failed upgrades in staging by 80% relative to previous runs, (c) clear operator-visible events and breakpoints in Console and CI logs, and (d) documented rollback path and runbook attached to each upgrade run.

Non-goals: this ticket does not implement full rollout UI in Console (only CI/automation hooks and logs). It also does not change existing customer-facing APIs for Private clusters.

2026-03-05 - Mateo: POC demonstration to infra guild. Feedback: make healthcheck assertions extensible and ensure we avoid implicit drifts from autoscaling groups. Action: add an explicit ignore list for autoscaling-managed attributes.
2026-03-08 - Design review: PM and Security requested KMS key rotation check and an explicit outage window annotation in the run metadata.
2026-03-10 - Mateo: Uploaded initial Terraform module (preflight-bridge v0.1) to private infra repo. Tests exercise pre-apply diff blocking behavior and basic kube-apiserver probe.
